headline: Contested Fronts Shift Across the War Line
war_summary: The latest returns show the pressure shifting rather than breaking. LinnMercy has come alive again, posting eight strategic-base events in two hours and 37 in the day; its holdings now stand at eight Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base. Godcrofts remains the most frenetic immediate sector, with 11 events in two hours and 37 across the day, leaving five Colonial, one Warden, and three neutral positions. MarbanHollow has also intensified, recording six recent events and 38 in the day, with four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base. PalantineBerm has cooled from the previous edition’s rush, falling to four events in two hours and 45 for the day, while its split is three Warden, four Colonial. StlicanShelf is quieter than before at two recent and 16 daily events, holding one Warden, seven Colonial, and one neutral base. WeatheredExpanse has seen no movement in two hours, though three events arrived in six and 40 in the day; six Warden and three neutral bases remain. Casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating on several fronts, notably CallahansPassage and Stonecradle, even where ownership records are presently still.
